products.name: Frase
products.note: SEO content AI; SERP analysis; competitive data scraping; search algorithm dependency

profile_text.body:
Frase is a content platform designed to help businesses and agencies produce and maintain web content that ranks in Google search results and earns citations from AI-powered search engines. The company describes itself as a content operating system that covers research, writing, optimization, and publishing in a single workflow, positioning the product as a replacement for multiple separate tools. The platform writes natively in 70 or more languages and offers adjustable autonomy, allowing teams to let Frase publish independently, queue drafts for human approval, or anything in between.

The core Frase product sits in the writing and editing category and centers on SEO and what the company calls GEO and AEO, shorthand for visibility in AI-generated answers and cited recommendations. It crawls a customer's site on arrival, scores each page for SEO and AI readiness, and ranks fixes by impact before drafting any content. On an ongoing basis it tracks rankings across Google and monitors citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI, alerting users when their share of voice shifts. The company also offers an MCP server, a CLI, and an API so the platform can be invoked directly from tools such as Claude and Cursor.

Pricing starts at $39 per month billed annually, with the Professional tier listed at $103 per month. Additional seats, credits, and AI prompts can be added as needed, and annual billing carries a 20 percent discount. The held facts record no litigation and no SEC filings associated with Frase.
